dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, localized high-intensity pixel clusters dispersed across the lateral flank, exhibiting high contrast against the dark base fur and lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A configuration of three prominent macro-annuli located on the upper mid-back forming a scalene triangle with the longest side oriented parallel to the dorsal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, deep-set concentric skin folds and heavy creasing visible in the cervical region where the head is retracted against the torso.
